excerpts: > The Transformers config originally had an incorrect entry that caused long-context performance degradation. This has been fixed in this [commit](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Medium-3.5-128B/commit/c4be198050fb5789774a55b92ed697becfbf20ae). GGUFs generated using the Transformers config prior to this commit are also affected. Please use the correct config for best performance.
- **Large Context Window**: Supports a 256k context window.
